governing_question: For which hydrological purposes and bounded material/boundary/horizon domains is the already-qualified fixed-partition Layer-ROM evidence sufficient to justify further purpose-specific validation, without requiring a universal low-dimensional Richards replacement?

GROUNDWATER_FIXED_SHORT_B01.bounded_finding: R4 is the blind minimum reduced LARE member crossing R2 and FMC on the frozen short-horizon groundwater vector in C4R.

GROUNDWATER_FIXED_ONE_DAY_B01.bounded_finding: R8 and R12 are the only reduced LARE members crossing both R2 and FMC at every 0.128-1.024 day checkpoint; R8 is the minimum demonstrated reduced member for this bounded purpose.
GROUNDWATER_FIXED_ONE_DAY_B01.caveat: Not a seasonal/regional coupled-groundwater acceptance claim.

GROUNDWATER_FIXED_ONE_DAY_B14.bounded_finding: Lower-zone R3 crosses both comparators on the groundwater vector at every checkpoint, while placement-matched R4/R8 outperform uniform U4/U8. The B01 R8 minimum does not transfer as a material-invariant rule.
GROUNDWATER_FIXED_ONE_DAY_B14.caveat: One homogeneous transferred material and fixed lower boundary.

GROUNDWATER_DYNAMIC_HEAD_B01.bounded_finding: R3-R12 cross R2 on frozen groundwater/profile vectors, but R2 itself misses reversal sequences in three of four histories. Lower-zone placement advantage transfers.
GROUNDWATER_DYNAMIC_HEAD_B01.caveat: No independently authorized dynamic-head FMC comparator or application threshold.

GROUNDWATER_DYNAMIC_HEAD_B14_HIGH_RES.bounded_finding: No reduced R3-R12 member crosses even the R512 high-resolution groundwater comparator in C5N; R5-R16 plateau while placement remains beneficial.
GROUNDWATER_DYNAMIC_HEAD_B14_HIGH_RES.caveat: This is a closure/propagation limitation for the tested dynamic prescribed-head family, not a universal rejection of Layer-ROM.

PROFILE_OR_SOIL_STATE_FIXED_B01.bounded_finding: R12 is the minimum and only reduced member crossing FMC when mapped 10-cm profile fidelity is retained in C4R.
PROFILE_OR_SOIL_STATE_FIXED_B01.caveat: Profile fidelity is more demanding than groundwater-output fidelity in this bounded workload.

PROFILE_OR_SOIL_STATE_FIXED_B14_ONE_DAY.bounded_finding: R8 is the minimum reduced member crossing FMC on the profile-inclusive vector at day 1.024 while groundwater-only crossing occurs already at R3.
PROFILE_OR_SOIL_STATE_FIXED_B14_ONE_DAY.caveat: No root uptake/ET or drought-state acceptance threshold.

LONG_TERM_REGIONAL_WATER_BALANCE.bounded_finding: Exact model water accounting is preserved, and cumulative exchange/storage are measured in several bounded runs, but no seasonal/annual regional water-balance workload has been prospectively qualified.
LONG_TERM_REGIONAL_WATER_BALANCE.caveat: Mass conservation is not equivalent to accurate partitioning of ET, drainage, recharge and storage over long horizons.

OPERATIONAL_SOIL_MOISTURE_DROUGHT.bounded_finding: Mapped profile fidelity has been tested under lower-boundary-driven laboratories, but no dedicated atmosphere/root-uptake drought workload or application threshold is present in current authority.
OPERATIONAL_SOIL_MOISTURE_DROUGHT.caveat: C4Z explicitly forbids generalizing its lower-zone placement evidence to surface-driven purposes.

EVAPOTRANSPIRATION_AND_ROOT_UPTAKE.bounded_finding: No dedicated LARE authority was located for ET/root-uptake response.
EVAPOTRANSPIRATION_AND_ROOT_UPTAKE.caveat: Requires fresh surface-driven evidence before representation sufficiency can be discussed.

DRAINAGE_AND_RECHARGE.bounded_finding: Bottom exchange magnitude, bias, sign and reversal timing are deeply characterized in the groundwater laboratories.
DRAINAGE_AND_RECHARGE.caveat: This does not yet establish regional/seasonal recharge or drainage-system fidelity.

FAST_EVENT_THRESHOLD.bounded_finding: Flux sign/reversal timing is a known discriminating axis. Low-dimensional or over-focused representations can create reversal errors, and high-resolution B14 dynamic-head comparison retains a propagation gap.
FAST_EVENT_THRESHOLD.caveat: No independently sourced event-threshold consequence envelope exists.

SCIENTIFIC_PROCESS_OR_EXTREME_INFERENCE.bounded_finding: Existing evidence is insufficient for mechanistic/extreme inference because profile fidelity, event tails and dynamic-head propagation remain representation-sensitive.
SCIENTIFIC_PROCESS_OR_EXTREME_INFERENCE.caveat: Full Richards remains the scientific reference.

cost_value_boundary.C4T_result: On one shared-host B01 fixed-water-table workload, LARE R3-R8 occupy a resolved cost-fidelity frontier and are cheaper than fine R16; R12 is more expensive than R16.
cost_value_boundary.reason: C4T host/workload evidence is not a portable production performance baseline and does not adjudicate application adequacy.

application_acceptance_boundary.groundwater: C4U remains blocked on externally governed H_app plus independent A_temporal/direct temporal head-error budget with immutable provenance.
application_acceptance_boundary.other_purposes: F-ROMV2 has no frozen final application thresholds; the current synthesis must not manufacture thresholds from observed ROM errors.

rationale: Repeated C5/C6 work shows that adding a universally robust reconstruction/closure to a very small state vector is itself a major numerical/modeling problem.
Existing evidence already demonstrates materially different representation needs for groundwater output versus profile state, and across material, boundary and horizon.
The scientific value now lies in mapping where simpler conservative representations are sufficient, not in forcing a single universal minimum state dimension.

next_authority.question: What minimum new blind workloads are needed to fill the purpose matrix without reusing exposed response for representation or tolerance selection?
constraints: Do not create application acceptance thresholds from existing errors.
Keep purpose classes separate: groundwater exchange, profile/soil moisture, ET/root uptake, long-term balance, fast events/extremes.
Use existing qualified LARE candidates and placement families; no new closure or state family in C6L.
Fresh workloads must be generated after preregistration and must include surface-driven forcing before any ET/drought claim.
Performance remains out of scope until a hydrological purpose gate is independently closed.
